required_controls.name: Service identity required
required_controls.why: Every service must have an identity before trust can be evaluated.

required_controls.name: mTLS required
required_controls.why: Service-to-service communication should be encrypted and identity-aware.

required_controls.name: Authentication required
required_controls.why: No service should assume internal network trust.

required_controls.name: Network policy required
required_controls.why: East-west traffic should be explicitly constrained.

required_controls.name: Least privilege required
required_controls.why: Services should only have the access needed for their documented purpose.

required_controls.name: Secrets externalized
required_controls.why: Secrets must not be hardcoded in application or infrastructure files.

required_controls.name: Observability enabled
required_controls.why: A security system must be measurable and auditable.

required_controls.name: No public exposure by default
required_controls.why: The MVP lab should remain private and local unless exposure is explicitly justified.
